title: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 Clark Review: A Third Nighttime Leg
seo_title: HOKA Midnight Run Asia Clark 2026 Review | RunRio
meta_description: HOKA Midnight Run Asia 2026 Clark review: November 15 -- the third leg of a premium shoe brand's nighttime race format in the Clark Freeport Zone.
dek: Set for 15 November 2026, this Clark leg is the third stop in the HOKA Midnight Run Asia series covered at its Cebu and Iloilo legs elsewhere in this research -- bringing the nighttime race format to Central Luzon.
verdict: The HOKA Midnight Run Asia's Clark leg completes a pattern visible across this research batch: the series has now run legs in Cebu, Iloilo and Clark, suggesting a genuinely national rollout rather than a one-off city event. Clark Freeport Zone -- the same venue hosting the Pampanga Marathon, Singlife ONE Clark Marathon and PUMA Philippine Half Marathon's Clark leg covered elsewhere in this research -- has proven repeat capacity for large-field races. Three distances (21K/10K/5K) keep the format standard, though registration status wasn't yet announced at the time of this research.

sections.heading: The Third HOKA Midnight Run Leg
paragraphs: The Clark leg of HOKA Midnight Run Asia offers 21K, 10K and 5K distances, organised by RunRio under the HOKA brand. [1] With Cebu and Iloilo legs already covered elsewhere in this research batch, Clark is the third confirmed stop in this series -- a pattern suggesting a genuinely national rollout rather than an isolated city event.

sections.heading: A Proven Large-Event Venue
paragraphs: Clark Freeport Zone has already demonstrated repeat capacity for large-scale races in this research batch -- the Pampanga Marathon has run annually since at least 2022, the Singlife ONE Clark International Marathon and PUMA Philippine Half Marathon's Clark leg are also held here. [2] That track record gives HOKA's Midnight Run a genuinely tested venue to work with, even as a newer addition to the calendar.

sections.heading: The Nighttime Format, Again
paragraphs: As with the Cebu and Iloilo legs, 'Midnight Run' signals a nighttime race format distinct from the pre-dawn starts typical of most Philippine road races. [1] Running this format in Clark's wide former-military-base roads (a legacy of the area's Clark Air Base history) could offer a genuinely different atmosphere from the Cebu and Iloilo legs' more urban settings.

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Announced
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status has not been announced. [1] No independent participant reviews were found for this leg, consistent with the series' newer stops covered elsewhere in this research.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you've been tracking the HOKA Midnight Run Asia series' rollout across Cebu and Iloilo, the Clark leg on 15 November 2026 extends that same nighttime format to a proven Central Luzon venue. Watch official channels closely for registration to open.
